subject: Bad interaction between ggplot2 (and plyr) and modeltools

messages.author: 71171f0d61fc140f
messages.subject: Bad interaction between ggplot2 (and plyr) and modeltools
parts:
Hi all,

I was playing around with the party package for classification and
regression trees, and one of its dependencies is modeltools. If
modeltools is loaded after plyr, its function empty() masks plyr's,
and nothing will plot.

library(modeltools)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(faithful, aes(eruptions, waiting)) + geom_point()
#success

detach(package:modeltools)
library(modeltools)

ggplot(faithful, aes(eruptions, waiting)) + geom_point()
# Error in function (classes, fdef, mtable) :
# unable to find an inherited method for function "empty", for
signature "data.frame"

-Joe

It is a problem with namespaces and function lookups, as you note. In
the development version, they are handled differently and this bug isn't
there.

Probably the best advice is to be careful with package loading order
until the next release comes out.
